Fernwood Coffee Co. The Fernwood Monthly
November 2026

Winter roasts are here

Our two winter single origins land in the café this week: a chocolatey Guatemala and a bright, berry-forward Ethiopia. Both are roasted in small batches every Tuesday.

Shop winter roasts
 

Also this month

Brewing tip

The 4:6 pour-over, explained

A simple way to dial in sweetness and strength with the beans you already have.

Read more →

From the farm

Meet the growers behind our Guatemala

How a family co-op in Huehuetenango shaped this year's favorite roast.

Read more →

Event

Free tasting on November 21

Taste both winter roasts side by side with our roasting team.

Read more →
Thanks for being part of the Fernwood community. Reply anytime — I read every message.
Maya Ruiz, Head Roaster
 

Fernwood Coffee Co. · 1420 Alder St, Portland, OR 97205

Fernwood Coffee Co.

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for stopping by the café last week and for the great questions about our roasting process. It's always fun to talk shop with someone who cares about coffee as much as we do.

As promised, here's the brewing guide we talked about. If you try the Ethiopia, I'd love to hear what you think.

Download the brewing guide (PDF)

Talk soon,

Maya Ruiz

Head Roaster, Fernwood Coffee Co.
